feeds.title: Kelly in the City
feeds.description: My name is Kelly Larkin, and this blog is where I document my life. While you'l find a whole lot of fashion-related content on Kelly in the City, my hope is that when you visit the site, you'll also get to know me as a person, and learn what's truly important to me.

feeds.title: Visions of Vogue
feeds.description: Visions of Vogue is a popular Chicago lifestyle and fashion blog written by Jenna who started it to share her passion for fashion and travels. While working in the finance industry, Jenna started Visions of Vogue as a creative outlet. She works full-time at her desk job and spends time on the blog when she's not in her cubicle.

feeds.title: Once Upon a Dollhouse
feeds.description: Once Upon a Dollhouse is a Chicago lifestyle blog featuring fashion, beauty, home decor, yoga, wellness, music festivals, crystal healing and more.

feeds.title: Gold Coast Girl Blog
feeds.description: My name is Samantha and this is my personal fashion + lifestyle guide. I created this blog as a creative outlet for me to express my love for all things related to fashion, food, fitness, home decor, beauty, and more recently motherhood.

feeds.title: Flo's Favorites
feeds.description: If you love discovering fresh places to visit, trying new things, and eating great food, you've come to the right place. My name is Flo and I'm a proud Midwesterner currently live in Chicago with my family.

feeds.title: Chi@Glance Blog
feeds.description: I'm Tavi. I'm a diehard Chicagoan that is always representing my city to the fullest. Whether you're new to town or a fellow Chi-Town native, I hope to share with you the joys of finding your new favorite hangout spot, happy hour specials to help you save a few dollars, establishments to help you celebrate that special occasion or ways to stay healthy after eating that bread pudding you splurged on last night.

feeds.title: Wishes & Reality
feeds.description: A Chicago based lifestyle blog featuring a mix of timeless classics and modern trends. Wishes & Reality was born in 2014 and focuses and fashion, food, home and family. The author is a wife and mom of two living in suburban Chicago.

feeds.title: Emma Lenhart
feeds.description: Emma Lenhart is a Chicago-based Lifestyle blog covering various topics including Fashion, Style, Money, College, Travel, and more!

feeds.title: Happily Ever Natural
feeds.description: Michelle is a wife, mom, lifestyle content creator + Social Media Strategist from Chicago, IL. On this blog, you will find all things lifestyle, beauty, mom life, travel and so much more.

feeds.title: Sportsanista
feeds.description: Sportsanista is a Chicago fashion blog that shares affordable and accessible fashion finds, beauty tips and game-day fashion. Her blog started out as a platform for women who work in sports to gain inspiration on incorporating fashion in to their everyday.

feeds.title: JZPThomas
feeds.description: A lifestyle blog focused on helping women become the best version of themselves through self-love and accountability. My name is JP. I am the writer and content creator behind this blog. I want to use each post as a way to connect with each of you and share my thoughts and advice on a variety of topics from fitness, health & wellness, healthy eating, to fashion and life hacks that make life a little bit easier.

feeds.title: Ela Bobak Blog
feeds.description: Ela Bobak is a Chicago based fashion blogger who shares home decor, travel, family life, her dogs, beauty, tips and tricks. She previously worked as a men's model agent and now works in advertising. Majoring in Fashion Business, Ela always had a love towards fashion and loves sharing about it.

feeds.title: IM-WORTHY
feeds.description: Hey there, I'm Shana Thomas. I share healthy recipes + wellness tips to help busy women live with more energy, improved healthy habits, and make an impact on the environment. I simplify their life with wellness hacks, my top meal prep, and vegan tips.

feeds.title: With Love, Melanie
feeds.description: With Love, Melanie is my happy place to be creative, have an outlet to share my passions, life adventures and everything in between.

feeds.title: Notes From Jo
feeds.description: Notes From Jo is a blog based in Chicago. Find thoughtful inspirations for every occasion, including ideas, tips, and how-to advice on fashion, food & drink recipes, decor, gift guides, entertaining, weddings, holidays and more. My name is Joanna and I'm a lover of all things fashion and beauty, a food and wine enthusiast and have a passion for entertaining.
